theorems.label: odd-cycle-transversal-treewidth-w1
theorems.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Odd Cycle Transversal within the stated running time. 2^(o_eff(t)) B^(O(1)). The graph is connected and has maximum degree at most three. For each fixed 0 < η < 1 the girth is at least n^(1−η), where n is the number of vertices. The pathwidth of G equals its treewidth. The exponent h(t) is finite and nonnegative and has a computable convergence modulus at the scale t. The exact width and an optimal path decomposition can be supplied and count in the complete input length.

title: Odd Cycle Transversal on subcubic graphs of large girth
